notes.title: Buccaneers Shipshape – OUT NOW!
notes.content: [p]If you enjoyed the colorful, fun world of Balacera Brothers, you'll have a great time with my new game: the pirate-themed beat 'em up Buccaneers Shipshape, which is available now![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39309369/537883708c74d395d2bf6965955cbf5407abaf04.png"][/img] [/p][p]It’s time to play as a swashbuckling pirate and reclaim your stolen ship and treasure map![/p][p]Enjoy![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1962760/Buccaneers_Shipshape/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Buccaneers Shipshape: Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I’m happy to announce that my new game, the pirate-themed Buccaneers Shipshape will officially launch on July 22nd , 11:00 AM (PDT)


[previewyoutube=8IIl20dcTiY;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8IIl20dcTiY[/previewyoutube]


It’s been a long road, and I’m exceedingly thankful for your support and patience!

All the best,
Merso

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1962760/Buccaneers_Shipshape/

notes.title: Balacera Brothers 1.0.4
notes.content:
Quick but necessary update that had a long time coming. 
- Fixed transition between running animation and running while shooting. The change of animations is more organic now, less jerky.
- Fixed last boss bug
